text:
maria: Quick follow-up on the rollout metadata schema - thinking about unifying 'pin' fields so the runtime can reason about evictions and fallbacks without extra calls. TL;DR proposal below. :eyes:

kevin: sketch it?

maria: Proposed minimal shape:
```json
{
  "model_id": "open-llama-13b-v2",
  "version_hash": "sha256:abcd...",
  "pin": {
    "mode": "soft",        // soft | hard
    "origin": "user",      // user | system | autoscaler
    "lease_seconds": 86400,  // optional, server enforces
    "compat": "backward"   // backward | strict | best-effort
  },
  "rollout": {
    "canary_pct": 10,
    "policy": "gradual"
  }
}
```

sunita: I like origin + lease. compat="backward" needs definition: does it mean convert on-the-fly or fallback? 

maria: good call. I meant: 'backward' = runtime may route to a compatible older variant if exact hash missing; 'strict' = failover only to pinned-compatible approved variants; 'best-effort' = try nearest size/capability.

kevin: migration concern: when clients are pinned to content-hash, kube-level GC will evict older builds unless lease keeps it alive. lease_seconds needs to be enforced by placement/eviction components.

oliver: ops question: how do we expose telemetry? we need pin_origin in console and per-tenant usage. Also visibility when runtime performs an automatic fallback.

deploy-bot: deploy success: rollout-metadata-service v1.3.0 -> prod :white_check_mark: 

sunita: edge case: what about shared caches/kv between model variants? If runtime routes to older variant should cache keys be invalidated? cache consistency could blow.

maria: recommendation: include a stable 'compat_tag' e.g., "kv:semver:2" that cache layer understands. If absent, runtime marks cache-miss-safe fallback and logs.

kevin: +1. Also add 'deprecation_ts' optional so clients know when a pinned model will be forcibly rotated.

maria: updated proposal: add compat_tag and deprecation_ts. I'll open a tiny RFC and a migration checklist (db backfill of existing pins -> set origin=system where unknown). Who wants to review?

oliver: i'll review for observability + UI bits.

sunita: i'll do ML infra/backwards test matrix.

kevin: i'll handle eviction/lease enforcement plan.

maria: thanks all. I'll post RFC link when drafted. :thumbsup:
